title: ActionApprovedV2
description: Gateway to executor: an action a human approved, with the tenant and the app it belongs to. action_id doubles as the executor's idempotency key: a proposed action's id, or the id of a restart plan a human approved.

tenant_id.description: The tenant whose alert led to the action.

app.description: The real app the tenant watches (LIVE_TENANTS), whose catalog the executor checks the target against. Null for a sim tenant, whose actions the executor never runs.

kind.description: Allowlisted action kinds; any other kind fails validation.

parameters.description: Kind-specific arguments, for example {"to_version": "v1.7.3"}; none for a restart plan.

approved_by.description: Approver identity as recorded by the gateway.
